summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due November 1, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq-100 and Russell 2000. Coupons are contingent at $7.50 monthly, with monthly autocall observation beginning July 27, 2027, pricing October 27, 2026 and issue October 30, 2026. Notes are senior unsecured Series A GMTN obligations, subject to credit risk. This is a routine structured-note shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch index levels versus barrier and coupon triggers.
